system.details:
A stark reminder of death and beauty, a fur taken from a once-great beast that now blankets and protects you. It gains two of the following benefits:

  • Leftover Eyes - You have 360 degree vision, and reduce the impact of any effect that makes it more difficult for you to see,
  • Feral Memory - Mark to gain a temporary two ranks in a skill related to the animal your fur was taken from. These ranks last until the end of the scene,
  • Leathern - You're resistant to Keen and Frost damage,
  • Jaws and Claws - Deals CQ Spike or Serrated damage (chosesn when you gain this aspect),
  • Sinewed - Treat Conflicts as Triumphs when leaping,
  • The Beast Without - When you mark the last box on this aspect's track, instantly hijack focus. An attack made with this focus has increased impact.
